notes.title: Update for achievements and windowed mode
notes.content:
Hello friends of Super Arcade Racing!

You've voiced your desire for a windowed mode, and we're excited to announce that it's now available with our latest update! Easily switch to Full Screen with a quick press of F11 or ALT+CTRL. Plus, we've tweaked the points required for certain achievements.

Otherwise, same pure racing fun, the arcade way!

'til next time!
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Cross-Platform Multiplayer Update and Sale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/6bd2e334ad616cb7c5410d8ad31bdd962fc3f893.jpg

Here's what's new...


 Cross-platform multiplayer
        You can now match with players on any platform that the game is available on, around the world, when playing multiplayer

 Anonymous leaderboard names
        Your leaderboard name is now made up of a set of wacky words, go to settings -> leaderboard name to change it as much as you want until you find something you like

 Bug Fixes
        We've fixed a few bugs and made a few improvements


We're also pleased to announce that to celebrate this update we're putting the game on sale next week at a 30% discount. This discount will start at 10AM PST / 6pm BST on the 3rd of August.

Here's a video showing off a game between three players on three different platforms:

[previewyoutube=eQG-uaF9Iow;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing!

- The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Split Screen Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/88dc067ecf79be51202e86e0b414f717a4232288.png

We’re pleased to announce we have a new major update for Super Arcade Racing! (v1.03)

Here’s what’s new...

 Split Screen
Now you can play with up to 4 players locally. Each player can customise their car and choose their car upgrade (limited to whatever has been unlocked in the single player).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/20c97969893287b672d8529f43b18a1c01a96685.png

 Online levels
We have added all the single player levels to the online multiplayer level selection options, giving you more levels to choose from (again, limited to whatever has been unlocked in the single player).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/84796c586c97fef5b1ea3c7f78b3b5c4df0ed1c1.png


 New Music
We have added new music into the game! Each level will now have a song playing.

We have also added a FREE DLC of the soundtrack. And for those who want the megamix YouTube compilation, you can now listen to it all here:

[previewyoutube=vIHf-8HMu6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have downloaded the DLC Soundtrack, you can find the .mp3 files here:

 In Steam, right click Super Arcade Racing
 Click ‘properties’
 Click ‘local files’ tab
 Click ‘Browse local files’
 There should be a folder called “Soundtrack”

Or alternatively, you can open up the steam overlay, click the music tab and see the Super Arcade Racing soundtrack there!

 Bug Fixes
Minor bug fixes and improvements



Thanks for playing, see you on the track!

- The OutOfTheBit Team
